# Bundled QR encoder

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified `dist/qrcode.js` from **qrcode-generator 2.0.4**,
published by Kazuhiko Arase under the MIT license (included alongside it).

- Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-2.0.4.tgz
- Distribution SHA-1 reported by npm: `e8b3f30922577eba52078aa9c0d5a2a74fe1fd94`

The library is bundled so runtime needs neither a network connection nor a
package install. Its UTF-8 byte encoder is enabled by the popup.
